project.name: SkillWeave Initiative 02 — Discovery, Research, and Design Thinking Lens
project.description: Create a Discovery & Research skill focus and operational Design Thinking Lens for SkillWeave

objectives.description: Create a discovery prompt library with 10+ structured prompts covering empathy, research, framing, and assumption surfacing
Operationalize design thinking workshop rules as configurable prompt behaviors and output formatting rules

success_metrics.target: Config loads and rules apply to skill outputs

tasks.title: Define Design Thinking Lens configuration schema
tasks.description: Create the configuration schema mapping workshop rules to prompt behaviors and UX principles to output rules. Define how the lens is loaded, activated, and applied across skills.
acceptance_criteria: Lens configuration schema defined in .skillweave/config.yaml extension
6 workshop rules mapped to concrete prompt behaviors
5 UX principles mapped to output formatting rules
Activation mechanism documented (opt-in via config)
Runtime loading pattern defined

tasks.title: Create discovery prompt library — empathy and user context
tasks.description: Write 3+ structured prompts for user empathy: persona development, user context mapping, pain point articulation. Each prompt has input requirements, expected output format, and artifact target.
acceptance_criteria: 3+ empathy/user-context prompts exist
Each prompt has defined inputs and output format
Prompts produce artifacts (files), not chat-only output
Prompts follow Design Thinking Lens rules
Prompts are reusable templates with placeholders
verification_steps: Test one prompt with sample input

tasks.title: Create discovery prompt library — research and landscape
tasks.description: Write 3+ structured prompts for research: competitor analysis, landscape mapping, market opportunity assessment. Each produces structured artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: 3+ research/landscape prompts exist
Competitor analysis prompt produces a matrix artifact
Landscape mapping prompt produces a structured overview
Each prompt has clear input and output specs
Prompts follow Scan Before Read principle
verification_steps: Test one prompt with sample input

tasks.title: Create discovery prompt library — framing and assumptions
tasks.description: Write 4+ structured prompts for problem framing, opportunity articulation, assumption surfacing, and assumption prioritization.
acceptance_criteria: 4+ framing/assumption prompts exist
Problem framing prompt produces structured problem statement
Assumption surfacing prompt extracts 5+ assumptions from any project description
Assumption prioritization uses risk matrix (impact × probability)
Outputs feed into Blueprint phase inputs
verification_steps: Test assumption surfacing with sample project description
Verify outputs are compatible with Blueprint skill input

tasks.title: Create research artifact templates
tasks.description: Build 5 artifact templates: persona-card.md, competitor-matrix.md, assumption-log.yaml, opportunity-canvas.md, research-summary.md. Place in .skillweave/templates/discovery/.
acceptance_criteria: 5 template files exist in .skillweave/templates/discovery/
Persona card template has sections for demographics, goals, pain points, usage context
Competitor matrix template supports multi-competitor comparison
Assumption log uses YAML with risk categorization
All templates follow Scan Before Read formatting
Templates are fillable from discovery prompt outputs
verification_steps: Check each template has placeholder sections

tasks.title: Implement ideation mode with divergent thinking
tasks.description: Build an ideation module that enforces quantity-first generation, deferred judgment, and wild idea inclusion. Configurable via lens settings.
acceptance_criteria: Ideation module exists and is importable
Generates minimum 5 options per invocation (configurable)
At least 1 option is flagged as unconventional/wild
Evaluation step is separate from generation step
Supports building on prior ideas (expansion mode)
Each option has brief rationale
verification_steps: Run ideation with sample problem → 5+ options
Run expansion on top of prior output

tasks.title: Implement assumption tracking system
tasks.description: Build assumption extraction, categorization, and tracking. Assumptions are stored in .skillweave/tracking-log/assumptions.yaml with risk scoring and validation status.
acceptance_criteria: Assumption extraction works from text input
Assumptions categorized by impact × probability
Validation methods suggested per assumption
Tracking file created at .skillweave/tracking-log/assumptions.yaml
Assumptions can be marked as validated/invalidated
verification_steps: Extract assumptions from sample project description
Verify YAML file created with correct structure
Update assumption status and verify persistence

tasks.title: Implement iteration quality framework
tasks.description: Build feedback synthesis template and evidence-driven revision patterns. Each iteration extracts learnings and tracks what changed and why.
acceptance_criteria: Feedback synthesis template exists for collecting input
Revision prompts reference evidence, not opinion
Learning extraction runs after each iteration
Iteration log tracks changes with rationale
Log persists in .skillweave/tracking-log/
verification_steps: Run feedback synthesis with sample input

tasks.title: Integrate lens and discovery with existing skills
tasks.description: Connect the Design Thinking Lens to Blueprint and PromptChain skills. Discovery outputs feed into Blueprint inputs. Lens rules apply to skill outputs when activated.
acceptance_criteria: Lens loads from config and applies to skill outputs
Discovery artifacts are discoverable by Blueprint skill
Assumption log feeds into PRD risk section
Existing skills work unchanged when lens is disabled
Integration documented in skill metadata
verification_steps: Activate lens → verify output formatting changes
Run Blueprint with discovery artifacts → verify they're used

tasks.title: Test suite for discovery and design thinking features
tasks.description: Tests covering prompt library, templates, lens configuration, ideation mode, assumption tracking, and integration.
acceptance_criteria: Test file exists with 12+ test cases
Prompt library completeness tests pass
Template validation tests pass
Lens configuration tests pass
Ideation mode output validation tests pass
Backward compatibility tests pass

assumptions.description: Design thinking principles can be meaningfully operationalized as prompt rules
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Lens becomes decorative rather than functional
assumptions.validation_method: Test lens-on vs lens-off output quality on 3 real scenarios

assumptions.description: Users benefit from structured research even in solo/indie contexts
assumptions.validation_method: Track discovery feature usage in first 10 projects

technical: Lens must be opt-in via config, not mandatory
Discovery prompts must produce files, not chat-only output
Must integrate with existing .skillweave/ directory structure
No external API dependencies for core discovery features

risks.description: Design thinking rules feel forced or artificial when applied to prompts
risks.mitigation: Make all rules opt-in, provide clear value examples, iterate based on feedback

risks.description: Discovery prompts too generic to produce useful research
risks.mitigation: Ground prompts in real scenarios, test with actual projects before finalizing

risks.description: Template explosion — too many artifact types create confusion
risks.mitigation: Start with 5 core templates, expand only based on demonstrated need

execution_recommendation.reason: 10 tasks, ~6 hours total, moderate dependencies, documentation-heavy
